svg.title: The boatyard and the bus stop, March
svg.desc: A boatyard beside a road with a boat for sale, a half-built extension, a job advert on a board, a bus to Galway and a college prospectus on a table.

g.text: The boatyard and the bus stop, March
Eleven things to find. Four of them are plans, not objects.
the boat that is not coming back
